messages:
marta_marketing: Quick kickoff: we're running a micro-experiment to simplify pricing language, add a compact cost estimator, and tighten the FAQ. Aim: fewer clicks to demo, clearer expectations, and smarter lead routing from the calculator.

jamal_growth: good. primary KPI?

marta_marketing: demo-click rate on /pricing (baseline 1.9% -> target 3.0%). secondary: calc_use_rate and sales-accepted leads. Also track support FAQ clicks.

rita_product: naming suggestion: "Hobby (trial)", "Team (shared)", "Committed (SLA)". Each label gets a one-line clarifier and small feature badges. avoid Pro/Enterprise.

noelle_design: i'll create two comps: (A) compact vertical cards with inline microlines, (B) horizontal strip with sticky mini-calculator. mobile-first.

alex_engineering: estimator logic is simple client-side: monthly_tokens * price_per_1k_by_tier + optional private_fee. events: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_input, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_calc_priority. will emit UTM and region.

paul_sales: routing asks: if tier=Committed AND "I need SLA/VPC" checked -> create SFDC lead with tag pricing_calc_committed, lead_score=70, note: "SLA/VPC interest". include est_monthly_usd and utm. also ping #sales-enterprise.

maya_cs: i'll draft 2-line FAQ snippets to sit under calculator results: billing cadence + cancellation window. also prepare 3 quick-reply templates for incoming questions.

jamal_growth: A/B plan? full page variant or incremental?

marta_marketing: 50/50: control = current pricing page; variant = simplified labels + compact calc + inline micro-FAQ. Run 4 weeks or until 7k visitors. Primary metric = demo CTA CTR. Secondary = calc_use_rate & demo->SQL within 21 days.

noelle_design: tooltip for estimator draft: "Estimates are ballpark. Includes token costs only; excludes egress & optional private deployment fees. For contract pricing, tick the box."

alex_engineering: implementation notes: webhook to /hooks/lead-ingest with retry and DLQ. will attach event payload: {"lead_source":"pricing_calc","tier":"Committed","est_monthly_usd":"...","priority":"high"}.

paul_sales: add a webinar opt-in checkbox on calc results for Committed picks; we'll run a short webinar on cost vs latency tradeoffs and batching. route webinar opt-ins to nurture list + enterprise outreach if priority checked.

publish_bot: Reminder: Experiment "pricing-simplify-mini-estimator" scheduled to deploy 2026-11-12 06:00 UTC. CI window reserved 04:00-06:00 UTC. :rocket:

marta_marketing: action items: noelle designs, alex events + webhook, jamal tracking, maya support content, paul webinar flow. reconvene 48h before deploy for smoke test. :thumbsup:
